body_text:
Over ZF, the axiom of choice is equivalent to each of the
following principles: every set can be well ordered; every
partially ordered set in which each chain has an upper bound has a
maximal element (Zorn's lemma); and every surjective function
admits a right inverse. The equivalences allow choice to enter a
proof in the form best adapted to its subject.
